graphs_examined_definition: Cumulative objective evaluation requests: baseline 2389, exhaustive k2 12172, k3 main 11076, structural checks 3; includes repeats. Does not count generation-only or second-solver checks.
current_strategy: Resolved five-root private-transversal q+e selection using exact piecewise profiles and a five-outside-vertex recoloring budget
next_goal: Select five vertices on residual nonautomatic critical cores without existing certificates; proper balanced pieces with at most five attachment roots and a private transversal now supply B

results.coverage: All triangle-free ten-vertex isomorphism classes, including disconnected graphs
Named positive-weight blow-up families plus seeded random and local searches; NOT all triangle-free graphs

supplementary_experiments.purpose: Counterexamples to stronger structural guesses; none violates JSP-000058

balanced_extension_audit.finite_status: COMPUTATIONALLY VERIFIED for homogeneous remainder-part neighborhoods
balanced_extension_audit.symbolic_status: PROVED for arbitrary extensions at t>=3, including strict equality classification
balanced_extension_audit.coverage_reduction_status: FALSIFIED: a mixed part need not admit a homogeneous triangle-free spanning supergraph

validation.scope: Targeted identity, coverage regression, saved artifacts, and structural analysis tests; historical full-suite validation retained separately

balanced_extension_cover_bound.key_inequality: W <= 8L+4 for an incompatible type edge; D >= tL

balanced_extension_t7.key_step: The only failures of W-7L<=4 are star and K2,3 configurations whose deficit budget forces compatible retyping into an unbalanced C5 blow-up

balanced_extension_t6.key_step: All exceptional internal shapes admit compatible retyping after at most two boundary-edge deletions, into a C5 blow-up with deletion distance 36

validation.scope: 1875 normalized type maps for three exceptional shapes, mixed-pattern loss-budget repair checks, existing identity and structural regressions; no full extension enumeration

balanced_extension_type_occupancy.key_step: Noninjective maps supply a cut of cost at most t^2+6 or t(t+1)+4; injective maps have W=m+2L and D>=tL; equality forces the complete balanced blow-up

validation.scope: 625 normalized occupancy maps, nonconstant cuts of all 388 triangle-free five-vertex graphs, injective overlap checks, existing balanced-pattern and structural regressions; no full extension enumeration

balanced_extension_t3.key_step: Injective m-L<=4; noninjective occupancies reduce to two forms with three explicit pair-of-cut certificates of summed costs 28,29,31

validation.scope: Occupancy classification, injective refinement, forced internal shape, per-pattern two-cut certificates and all legal attachments, existing balanced-pattern and structural regressions; no extension enumeration

induction_critical_core.transfer: d(C)=d(G) and C spanning subgraph imply gamma_G(X)=gamma_C(X)-[d(G-X)-d(C-X)]<=gamma_C(X) for every X
induction_critical_core.falsified: Same transfer without equal deletion distances

validation.scope: Exact core transfer on fixed examples and all five-deletions; critical-edge witnesses on 388 small graphs; every edge of 126 positive order-10 C5 blow-ups; existing balanced-pattern and structural regressions

induction_cut_slack.counterexample: Petersen disjoint-union B_s, s>=3; specified five-set has gamma=s+3 and optimal-cut maximum s+2
induction_cut_slack.counterexample_scope: Symbolic infinite family of nonautomatic triangle-free edge-critical cores; not a counterexample to A or B

validation.scope: 512 Petersen cuts, all 638 deletions of size at most five, slack-one witness, B_3 component certificate; existing core and balanced-pattern regressions

induction_connected_slack.family: K_a = one-vertex union of J_a, B_(2a+3), C13; a>=1
induction_connected_slack.formulas: k=4a+6; d=4a^2+15a+10; gamma=3a+1; L=2a+1; minimum maximizing slack=a
induction_connected_slack.limitations: Specified five-sets satisfy B; graphs have a cut vertex; no reduction to 2-connected cores proved

validation.scope: Rooted block-cut gluing tables and graph structure; existing amplified-boundary, cut-slack and critical-core regressions

induction_threshold_slack.threshold_rule: gamma(X)<=T iff r_X(c)<=T+s(c) for all cuts with 0<=s(c)<=U_X-T-1
induction_threshold_slack.limitations: No five-set selection theorem or constant-width window; A_window/B_window equivalent to A/B, not established

validation.scope: Every five-set of four fixed order-10 graphs, every remainder coloring and integer threshold 0 through U+1; known positive-slack obstruction and existing full-cut regressions

induction_two_connected_slack.family: F_(a,h): J_a and B_h share deleted vertices 0,1 in A_0; subdivide private edge 79 to length nine
induction_two_connected_slack.formulas: k=2a+h+2; d=3a+h^2; gamma=3a+3h; L=2a+3h; minimum maximizing slack=a
induction_two_connected_slack.threshold_specializations: h=a+3: gamma=T_B+1; h=a+4: gamma=T_A+1; first violating slack=a in each case
induction_two_connected_slack.limitations: Specified five-sets fail; another five-set has increment at most one. No counterexample to A/B, no reduction to 2-connected cores, no conflict with graph-dependent windows.

validation.scope: Exact shared-boundary and part-count tables for a=1,2,3 with h=a+3,a+4; graph connectivity after each vertex deletion; path parity tables; existing amplification and cut-slack regressions

induction_thread_selection.formula: gamma_C(X)=D(K)-D(K-S)+j for interior/cycle/isolate deletions; S is the set of hit paths and j the number of hit odd cycle components
induction_thread_selection.single_critical_path_loss: Exactly one for any nonempty interior deletion
induction_thread_selection.opposite_parity_parallel_pair_loss: Exactly one when both interiors are hit, without requiring criticality
induction_thread_selection.capacity_selection_status: PROVED sufficient criterion, with exact vertex-count feasibility
induction_thread_selection.additivity_of_critical_path_losses: FALSIFIED by two even and two odd parallel paths
induction_thread_selection.limitations: No selection theorem on residual cores; no reduction to minimum degree four; low-degree count restriction for k>=4 is a consequence of the preexisting sequential bound

validation.scope: 1536 deletion subsets across five fixed decompositions; every original edge deletion versus signed prediction; prescribed path-edge parity witnesses; two five-set constructions; critical-core transfer regressions
validation.initial_test_correction: Expected subset count corrected from 1920 to 1536; mathematical assertions passed on the initial run

induction_pendant_selection.profile: For s>=2 and j=0,...,5: f_s(j)=(0,s,s,2s-1,2s-1,2s-1), avoiding one prescribed root
induction_pendant_selection.pendant_selection_status: PROVED: proper pendant B_s, s>=2, supplies gamma=2s-1<=2k-3
induction_pendant_selection.block_family_status: PROVED: A/B for critical cores whose nontrivial blocks are balanced C5 blow-ups or odd cycles, with usual balanced exception for B
induction_pendant_selection.limitations: No reduction to 2-connected cores; arbitrary leaf blocks remain. Multiple attachment vertices are not covered.
induction_pendant_selection.two_boundary_additivity: FALSIFIED by paths of lengths two and three forming C5

validation.scope: 398 rooted B1/B2 deletion subsets; 764 one-root gluing checks; two-piece allocation; B3 transversal; order-20 nonautomatic higher-degree core with explicit q=0/e=3; existing core-transfer regressions

induction_two_boundary_selection.boundary_profile_status: PROVED: any coloring of at most two vertices of B_s extends at cost s^2
induction_two_boundary_selection.selection_status: PROVED: private transversal has gamma=2s-1; proper balanced piece gives gamma<=2k-3
induction_two_boundary_selection.feasibility: s>=3, or s=2 with at most one attachment vertex per part
induction_two_boundary_selection.q_plus_e: Constructed remainder-optimal coloring has q=0 and e=2s-1
induction_two_boundary_selection.limitations: No general reduction to balanced pieces or 3-connected cores; s=2 with two roots in one part excluded

induction_three_boundary_selection.profile: F_s(a)=s^2+delta(a), delta in {0,2} independent of s for at most three roots
induction_three_boundary_selection.selection: Private transversal has gamma=2s-1 and a q=0 witness; proper pieces satisfy B
induction_three_boundary_selection.falsified: Flatness of every three-root boundary profile

validation.scope: 20 normalized symbolic profile rows with 32 templates each; full cuts of every B_1/B_2 triple; nonflat gluing and nested optimum; existing two-boundary tests

induction_four_boundary_selection.selection: Private transversal has 2s-1<=gamma<=2s+1 and a q=0 upper-bound witness; proper pieces supply A; s<=k-2 supplies B
induction_four_boundary_selection.falsified: Universal size-independent boundary penalty and universal exact private-transversal increment 2s-1 for four roots
induction_four_boundary_selection.counterexample: Two opposite-colored pairs in nonadjacent parts, enforced by M=2s+1 internally disjoint length-three paths per pair; actual gamma=2s+1
induction_four_boundary_selection.limitations: No reduction to balanced pieces or higher connectivity; the former s=k-1 B gap is resolved in notes/INDUCTION_FOUR_BOUNDARY_BUDGET.md; no edge-criticality claim for the unrestricted-outside counterexample

validation.scope: 47 symbolic rows, 32 quadratic templates each, exhaustive orbit coverage, full cuts of all four-root sets in B1/B2, independent part-count and path-cut gluing at s=3,4,5, existing three-boundary regressions

induction_four_boundary_budget.single_bottleneck: Private-transversal B selection at s=k-1 with four retained attachment roots
induction_four_boundary_budget.key_step: All three slope-two rows admit a one-root flip to slope zero whose added outside cost plus constant penalty is at most 2t when at most five vertices lie outside
induction_four_boundary_budget.profile: After gluing at most five outside vertices, d(B_t union R)=t^2+K with K independent of admissible t
induction_four_boundary_budget.selection: Every proper balanced piece with at most four attachment roots and a private transversal supplies gamma<=2k-3; at s=k-1 the exact increment is 2s-1
induction_four_boundary_budget.q_plus_e: A remainder-optimal coloring with q=0 attains the stated extension bound in the piece graph; equal-d core transfer preserves gamma, not necessarily q=0
induction_four_boundary_budget.limitations: No general reduction to balanced pieces; arbitrary residual cores and mixed balanced extensions t=2 remain open

validation.scope: Three slope-two orbit flip certificates; all independent root neighborhoods and outside colors; all reachable aggregate flip-cost vectors for N<=5; independent feasible-part-count glued minima and nested optimal cuts; existing four- and three-boundary regressions

induction_five_boundary_selection.single_bottleneck: Private-transversal A/B selection for balanced pieces with five retained attachment roots
induction_five_boundary_selection.profiles: 111 root-color orbits; penalties 0,2,4,6,2s,2s+2,min(2s,8); exact integer-polynomial certificates
induction_five_boundary_selection.outside_budget: 14 nonconstant orbits dominated by constant rows when N<=5, using weighted single-root and two-root flips
induction_five_boundary_selection.selection: Every proper balanced piece with at most five attachment roots and a private transversal supplies gamma<=2k-3; at s=k-1 exact gamma=2s-1
induction_five_boundary_selection.q_plus_e: Explicit q=0 upper-bound coloring; at s=k-1 e=2s-1; equal-d core transfer preserves increment, not necessarily q=0
induction_five_boundary_selection.falsified: A single quadratic polynomial describes every five-root profile for all admissible sizes
induction_five_boundary_selection.limitations: No reduction of arbitrary cores to balanced pieces; mixed balanced extensions t=2 remain open

validation.scope: 111 all-size orbit certificates; full vertex cuts of every five-root set/coloring in B1/B2; 14 recoloring inequalities against all independent root neighborhoods; direct feasible-part-count glued minima and nested optimal cuts; existing four-boundary regressions
